validation.alignment: exact variant sets; joined by mutant; folds-table order

configuration.outer_cv: fixed five position folds from CSV
configuration.alpha_selection: minimum unweighted mean validation MSE across inner folds
configuration.preprocessing: StandardScaler inside Pipeline fitted in every inner split; refit on outer train
configuration.summary: unweighted fold mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1); pooled OOF separate
configuration.randomness: deterministic GroupKFold and Ridge; no random sampling
configuration.embedding_revision: not recorded in original artifacts; input bytes identified by SHA-256

limitations: One assay and fixed five position folds; no independent protein benchmark.
Fold SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval; training sets overlap.
Representation comparisons use the same outer folds; selecting the winner makes these folds exploratory.
Zero-shot scores are rankings, not calibrated fitness; RMSE/MAE are reported only for regressors.
Pooled OOF Spearman also compares predictions from different fitted models across folds.
